name: Eógobal
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eógobal was an obscure figure of Irish belief, classed as a god. The sources call him the father, or perhaps the grandfather, of two goddesses. Little else is known about him, and he appears only in brief mentions. His name survives mainly through the family ties noted in the tradition.
